publications.title: Temporal Analysis on Topics Using Word2Vec
publications.subtitle: ArXiv
publications.description: In this study, we have developed a novel method for trend detection that goes beyond conventional approaches. While existing methods primarily assess the popularity of individual words based on frequency, our approach offers a deeper analysis. We not only gauge a topic's popularity but also its trajectory, particularly within a specific subtopic amid related content.

organizations.title: Artificial Intelligence Club
organizations.description: There are more and more high schoolers that want to learn about Artificial Intelligence (AI). This club serves as a community/hub for Howard High School students to learn about AI and create AI projects to learn its various applications. With my experience in AI, I lead lessons and activities for learning AI and plan projects for understanding the AI model development process.

organizations.title: FTC Robotics Team 17394
organizations.description: First Tech Challenge (FTC) hosts their annual FTC Robotics Competition to challenge the high school engineering community to apply their expertise in a competitive spirit. In our school team, FTC Team 17394, I lead code development for our robot's software, mentor new members in learning the Java FTC library, and teach the applications of object-oriented programming in our software.
